Oink 0.1.3 improves screen arrangement, in-app updates and audio diagnostics.

## New

- Gaps between screens now close up only after you move or resize a screen yourself; a new toolbar button turns this off.
- Updates now open as a dialog in the main window, with download progress in the title bar and on the Cancel download button.
- Diagnostics has a new audio quality chart showing buffer, bitrate and dropouts per device over the last minute, with each dropout marked on the chart.
- On Windows without native touchpad input support, multi-finger gestures fall back to standard shortcuts and the touchpad setting is hidden.

## Fixes

- Fixed offline screens being hard to see in dark mode.
- Fixed the settings page background and content appearing at different times.
- Fixed pairing on Windows sometimes failing to finish when the computer is busy.
- Fixed a rare case where audio forwarding could fail to start or restore muting.
- Windows updates now clean up their downloaded files after installing.

## Downloads

- **Mac:** the `.dmg` file — Apple silicon, macOS 14.2 or later. Developer ID signed and notarized.
- **Windows:** the `.msi` file — x64, Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or later, or Windows 11. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen runtime (preinstalled on current Windows).

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

## Known limitations

- The Windows MSI is not code-signed in this release. SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info → Run anyway**. UAC shows an unknown publisher.
